name: box-plot
summary: How values spread in each group: a box from the 25th to the 75th percentile with the median across it, whiskers to the furthest values within 1.5 boxes, and dots past them. Send one row per value; Tiles computes the rest. Takes an axis title.

roles.name: x
roles.doc: the group each value belongs to

roles.name: y
roles.doc: one value, such as one deal's days to close
